definition: הֹר proper name, of a mountain 1. mountain on border of Edom, always הֹר הָהָר , named as stage in Israel's journey to CanaanNum Ezek 20:22 ; Ezek 21:4 ; Ezek 33:37 ; Deut 32:50 as place of Aaron's death Num 20:23 ; Num 20:25 ; Num 20:27 ; Num 33:38 ; Num 33:39 ; Num 33:41 ; Deut 32:50 (all P ); = modern Jebel Nebi Hârûn approximately 50 miles south of Dead Sea, just south (southwest) of Petra, according to Rob BR ii. 125, 152 , compare 519 ff. Bd Pal 153 ; disputed by Ew Kn Di , & especially Trumbull Kadesh Barnea 128 ff. , who thinks of J. Madurah , northwest of Edom. 2. a northeast spur of Lebanon Num 34:7 ; Num 34:8 ( P ); modern Jebel Akkar compare Porter Damascus, ed. 2, p. 333 Nbr Geogr. du Talm. p. 9 Furrer ZPV viii. 27 ; yet see Di .
